instruction: From now on, I always want cubes on the purple zone, cups on the cyan zone and books on the orange zone. Please tidy the table that way.

attempts.code:

red_book = observe()["objects"]["red_book"]
orange_zone = observe()["zones"]["orange_zone"]
dx = orange_zone["center"][0] - red_book["center"][0]
dy = orange_zone["center"][1] - red_book["center"][1]
go_home()
wait(1)
pick("red_book", 0.02, 0)
wait(1)
place("orange_zone", dx, dy)
wait(1)
go_home()
